nodes.description: ATP1A3 is expressed in cardiac conduction tissue in addition to neurons. A multicenter cohort found frequent resting and Holter ECG repolarization or conduction abnormalities across the ATP1A3-related syndrome spectrum (AHC, RDP, CAPOS), with dynamic serial-ECG changes and normal echocardiography (a primary electrical, not structural, disease). An Atp1a3 knock-in mouse showed baseline intracardiac conduction delay that progressed to heart block or complete sinus arrest during induced seizures, causing sudden death - a seizure-triggered mechanism for sudden cardiac death that parallels the human life-threatening-arrhythmia risk identified in this cohort.
